explanationMd:
Multiply every term of the first factor by every term of the second, keeping the signs attached to the numbers they belong to.

$$(3x)(2x) = 6x^2$$
$$(3x)(-7) = -21x$$
$$(5)(2x) = 10x$$
$$(5)(-7) = -35$$

Now combine the two middle terms:

$$-21x + 10x = -11x$$

So $(3x + 5)(2x - 7) = 6x^2 - 11x - 35$, which is Choice A.

Two checks are worth building into your routine. First, the constant term of a product is always the product of the two constants: $5 \times (-7) = -35$, so any option ending in $+35$ can be dismissed on sight. Second, substitute a convenient number. At $x = 1$ the original expression is $(3 + 5)(2 - 7) = 8 \times (-5) = -40$, and Choice A gives $6 - 11 - 35 = -40$. A single substitution separates the correct expansion from all three distractors here.

distractorRationale.d: This multiplies only the first terms and the last terms, dropping the two cross products $(3x)(-7)$ and $(5)(2x)$ entirely. At $x = 1$ it gives $-29$ rather than $-40$.
distractorRationale.c: This reverses the signs of both cross products, $+21x - 10x = +11x$ instead of $-21x + 10x = -11x$: it is the expansion of $(3x - 5)(2x + 7)$. The $-7$ must keep its sign through the multiplication.
distractorRationale.b: This gets the middle term right but multiplies the constants as if both were positive, giving $+35$ instead of $5 \times (-7) = -35$.

accessibilityText: Expand the product of the binomials 3x plus 5 and 2x minus 7, and choose the equivalent expression from four quadratic expressions.

provenance.notes: Original item. Coefficients chosen so that each distractor isolates a single, distinct sign or omission error.

independentSolve.workingNotes: FOIL: 6x^2 - 21x + 10x - 35 = 6x^2 - 11x - 35, which is (a). (b) has the wrong sign on the constant (5 times -7 is -35), (c) has the wrong sign on the x-term, and (d) leaves out the cross terms entirely.

review.notes: Author solved and checked uniqueness: expansion gives 6x^2 - 21x + 10x - 35 = 6x^2 - 11x - 35. Verified by substitution at x = 1 (original -40; A -29, B -18, C 30, D -40).
